items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then there was Hugh McCracken. Fantastic guitar. He did great imitations of Elvis Presley.

ctx.x: He has a foot… You know. I don’t have to… The foot… [imitating drummer] I would be a drummer, too, you know. And that’s Steve. And then there was Hugh McCracken. Fantastic guitar. He did great imitations of Elvis Presley. And he… you know, I couldn’t do. But he, yeah. And then who else? Richard Tee.
